rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a road, border, or other physical checkpoint.

example.english: There’s a checkpoint ahead, so drive more slowly.
example.traditional: 前面有個檢查站，慢啲揸。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 jau5 go3 gim2 caa4 zaam6 maan6 di1 zaa2

rows.note: Use this for a checkpoint in a video game, race, map, or level that the player must pass.

example.english: Once you pass this checkpoint, you can continue.
example.traditional: 呢關過咗檢查點就可以繼續。
example.jyutping: ni1 gwaan1 gwo3 zo2 gim2 caa4 dim2 zau6 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6

rows.note: Use this narrower game term when the checkpoint specifically saves progress for resuming after death or restarting.

example.english: Once you reach this checkpoint, you can restart from here even if you die.
example.traditional: 到咗呢個存檔點，死咗都可以由呢度再開始。
example.jyutping: dou3 zo2 ni1 go3 cyun4 dong2 dim2 sei2 zo2 dou1 ho2 ji5 jau4 ni1 dou6 zoi3 hoi1 ci2

rows.jyutping: zi1 liu2 fu3 gim2 caa4 dim2
rows.note: Use this technical term for a database state that can be restored after a failure.

example.english: After a failure, the system can be restored to the database checkpoint.
example.traditional: 故障後可以回復到資料庫檢查點。
example.jyutping: gu3 zoeng3 hau6 ho2 ji5 wui4 fuk6 dou3 zi1 liu2 fu3 gim2 caa4 dim2
